summary:
This page is **blank**. In printed books, blank pages appear so that important pages (title page, chapter openings) start on a right-hand, odd-numbered page. Here it is the reverse side of the "Praise for the Second Edition" page (p.3).

**How to use it:** skip ahead. The title page is on p.5, the brief contents on p.7, and chapter 1 begins on p.25.
takeaways: This page is intentionally blank; continue to the title page on p.5.
